name: Takato Matsuki
main_effect:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[Your Turn] When any of your Digimon digivolve into a Digimon with [Growlmon] or [Gallantmon] in its name, by suspending this Tamer, that Digimon gains ＜Raid＞ for the turn. (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.) Then, that Digimon attacks a player.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
